step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram displays a multi-tier IoT architecture categorized into Connectivity, Processing, Storing, and Analyzing layers. User devices (LG ThinQ) connect to AWS IoT Core, which routes data to processing nodes (EC2 and Lambda). These processing nodes persist structured and time-series data into RDS and DynamoDB. Kinesis Data Firehose streams analytical data directly to S3.
